source.history_mode: blobless fetch of official stable maintenance branches; exact source branches recorded below

limitations: Records are explicit CVE identifiers in commit messages; patch-only, advisory-only, and external-feed-only evidence remains outside this registry.
A commit reachable from a release tag does not by itself prove a patch remains effective in the tagged package tree.
Exact subject-prefix to manifest-package matching is a presence prefilter, not component identity or vulnerability applicability.
Rows repeated across releases are not independent and must be clustered by commit and CVE.
No human labels, method outputs, effect metrics, or submission claims are present.
